headline: Sources: Singapore's PDG plans US$1.2 billion loan for Johor data center
summary: Princeton Digital Group, a Singapore-headquartered data centre operator, is reportedly seeking a syndicated loan of up to US$1.2 billion to build facilities in Johor, Malaysia. The move follows a wave of AI-related borrowing.
why: Data centre operators build and lease the computing capacity that AI and cloud providers rely on, so their financing signals demand for AI infrastructure.
